name: Tomsy Thomas Kurian
head: Sr. Strategic Account Sales Manager - India Region, Cyient
text: Sr. Strategic Account Sales Manager - India Region, Cyient

strengths: Sells engineering and digital services and wins new accounts; owns account P&L (margin and utilisation)
Has acquired technology and product companies around Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Hyderabad and NCR, which is the GCC/captive buyer base
gaps: Sells engineering, embedded and EMS services rather than testing (QE), and mostly to the India region
screen.next: Ask him how many India captives/GCCs he has won in the last 2 years. If he is open to a move, he would be a direct GCC hunter.

name: Hemanth Desetty
head: Enterprise & Strategic Sales, JFrog APAC (ex-LambdaTest APAC founding seller)
text: Enterprise & Strategic Sales, JFrog APAC (ex-LambdaTest APAC founding seller)

strengths: Built LambdaTest's APAC business from scratch, winning 75+ enterprise customers in year one, so he knows testing buyers well
Owns new-logo revenue at JFrog; top 1% club
gaps: Has always sold SaaS/DevOps tools, never services
His territory is India, Dubai and SEA rather than US/UK
screen.next: He has QE and DevOps buyer relationships. Pitch the move from tools to QE + DevOps services hunting.

strengths: Has been a sales leader at KPIT and Birlasoft and was earlier at Hexaware
gaps: Background is India regional and BI licence sales; no evidence of global or GCC hunting
screen.next: Low priority. Confirm his current role and territory.

strengths: Closes $300K-$1M+ ARR deals with Fortune 500 CIOs in the Americas and EMEA
gaps: SaaS product seller with no services P&L
screen.next: Only if IGS is open to hiring from SaaS

name: Balamurugan G
head: Senior Enterprise Account Manager, Bentley Systems
text: Senior Enterprise Account Manager, Bentley Systems

strengths: Engages GCCs/GTCs for engineering software; hits 110-145% of quota
gaps: Sells engineering software licences, not services
screen.next: Use for referrals into GCC engineering leaders

name: Vineet Bansal
head: AVP - CAE Software & Services, Trident Techlabs
text: AVP - CAE Software & Services, Trident Techlabs

strengths: Leads a 12-person team bringing in multi-million new business for CAE/digital twin software
gaps: Sells engineering simulation software resale in India only
No IT services, testing (QE) or global market experience
